meter: tokens(request) = sum over its messages of (UTF-8 bytes of text, tool calls and thinking, + 16) / 4; cache_reuse = share of request tokens in the leading messages that the request before also sent; cost units = 0.1 per cached token + 1.25 per other token; dollars use the dated price card

engine.name: drop
engine.about: Floor: the window that cuts in steps, like ACE. Past the budget it keeps the newest messages that fit 0.6 of it, from a user message, and then only appends until the budget again, so its prefix stays cached between cuts. No layer. Port of ace_bench's Drop. The fold share 0.6 is the value that ace_bench passed to it in the runs of Nov 9 2026 (ace.FOLD_TO then; ACE has 0.9 now).
